title: A rework re-dispatched right after its attempt ends starts in its worktree
description: GY-3689: the loop's close step reclaims ended attempts' worktrees on a real Git repository. An item whose attempt just ended with a submission keeps its worktree, so the rework launched next resolves that path and its branch with no ENOENT; an ended attempt whose path nothing reuses is still removed.

steps.name: the re-dispatched rework starts in its kept worktree
